mapper.select:
select distinct t.test_id as id, t.test_name as text from STT_STRESS_TEST t left join STT_STRESS_TIPS t2 on t.tmpl_id=t2.tmpl_id where t2.dict_code='RISK_TYPE' and t2.tips_value='03' and t.test_id is not null and t.test_name is not null
and ( t.test_id LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') or t.test_name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') )

select sst.tmpl_id as tmplId, sstm.tmpl_name as tmplName, (select t.item_value from sys_datadict_list t where t.dict_code='RISK_TYPE' and t.item_code='03') as riskType from STT_STRESS_TIPS sst left join STT_STRESS_TMPL sstm on sst.tmpl_id=sstm.tmpl_id where sst.dict_code='RISK_TYPE' and sst.tips_value='03'

select * from ( select ROWNUM AS rowno, a.*, b.tips_value as risk_type from stt_scene a left join stt_scene_tips b on a.scene_id = b.scene_id and b.dict_code = 'RISK_TYPE' and b.tips_value = '03' where a.scene_name like '%' || #{sceneStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' or a.scene_id like '%' || #{sceneStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' ) r
r.rowno <= 50 and r.risk_type = '03' and r.is_tmpl = '02'
